    all_true_selector = rasp.Select(

    return rasp.SelectorWidth(all_true_selector).named("length")

def make_frac_prevs(bools: rasp.SOp) -> rasp.SOp:
    """Fraction of previous tokens where a specific condition was True."""
    bools_num = rasp.numerical(bools)
    # Select all previous indices (including current)
    prevs = rasp.Select(rasp.indices, rasp.indices, rasp.Comparison.GEQ)
    # For each position, count number of previous True tokens
    num_true_prevs = rasp.Aggregate(prevs, bools_num, default=0)
    # For each position, count number of previous tokens (i+1)
    num_prevs = rasp.Aggregate(prevs, rasp.Map(lambda x: 1, rasp.tokens), default=0)

    frac_prevs = rasp.SequenceMap(
        lambda num, denom: 0 if denom == 0 else num / denom, num_true_prevs, num_prevs

    return frac_prevs.named("frac_prevs")

    bools_open = sop == open_token
    opens = make_frac_prevs(bools_open)
    bools_close = sop == close_token
    closes = make_frac_prevs(bools_close)
    pair_balance = rasp.SequenceMap(lambda x, y: x - y, opens, closes)
    return pair_balance.named("pair_balance")

    """Returns True if a set of parentheses are balanced, False else."""
    assert len(pairs) >= 1

    # Compute running balance of each type of parenthesis
    balances = []
    for pair in pairs:
        assert len(pair) == 2
        open_token, close_token = pair
        balance = make_pair_balance(
            rasp.tokens, open_token=open_token, close_token=close_token
        ).named(f"balance_{pair}")
        balances.append(balance)

    # Check if balances are negative anywhere -> parentheses not balanced
    any_negative = balances[0] < 0
    for balance in balances[1:]:
        any_negative = any_negative | (balance < 0)

    # For each position, check if any previous position had a negative balance
    select_all = rasp.Select(rasp.indices, rasp.indices, rasp.Comparison.TRUE).named("select_all")
    has_neg = rasp.Aggregate(select_all, any_negative, default=False).named("has_neg")

    # Check if all balances are 0 at the end (i.e., at the last position)
    all_zero = balances[0] == 0
    for balance in balances[1:]:
        all_zero = all_zero & (balance == 0)

    # Select only the last position
    select_last = rasp.Select(rasp.indices, length - 1, rasp.Comparison.EQ).named("select_last")
    last_zero = rasp.Aggregate(select_last, all_zero, default=False).named("last_zero")

    # The sequence is balanced if there was never a negative balance and the last balance is zero
    not_has_neg = ~has_neg
    result = last_zero & not_has_neg
    return result.named("shuffle_dyck")

def make_shuffle_dyck2() -> rasp.SOp:
    return make_shuffle_dyck(pairs=["()", "{}"]).named("shuffle_dyck2")
